quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a language exchange app matching native speakers for mutual free practice.
quests.correctAnswer: You teach your language, a partner teaches theirs - real practice, and it never costs a thing.
quests.hint: Highlight the mutual exchange and the zero cost together.
quests.explanation: A mutual exchange creates a sustainable free model that paid language apps can't easily compete with.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a carry-on-friendly phrasebook app that works completely offline in remote areas with no signal.
quests.correctAnswer: No signal, no problem - every key phrase is already on your phone before you land.
quests.hint: Lead with the offline reliability, not the phrase list.
quests.explanation: Working with zero signal solves the exact moment travellers need a phrasebook most.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a corporate language training platform with live tutors available around the clock.
quests.correctAnswer: A live tutor is available at any hour, so learning fits every time zone your team works in.
quests.hint: Emphasise round-the-clock access for global teams.
quests.explanation: Round-the-clock access matters most to global teams spread across very different working hours.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a reading app for children that automatically adjusts the difficulty as they improve.
quests.correctAnswer: Every story quietly gets a little harder as your child improves, always the perfect challenge.
quests.hint: Highlight the adaptive progression that grows with the child.
quests.explanation: Adaptive difficulty keeps a child in the sweet spot between bored and frustrated.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an early maths app that uses adventure storytelling to make numbers meaningful.
quests.correctAnswer: Kids solve number problems to help characters they love win the adventure - maths that feels like play.
quests.hint: Connect the maths directly to the story's motivation.
quests.explanation: Wrapping numbers inside a story a child cares about makes abstract maths feel worth doing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a monthly children's science kit with guided illustrated experiment cards.
quests.correctAnswer: Each box brings a safe experiment with simple picture instructions - real science kids can do themselves.
quests.hint: Emphasise the hands-on, guided approach.
quests.explanation: Hands-on experimenting builds curiosity in a way that watching a screen never quite matches.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an online university offering degree-equivalent qualifications in half the usual time.
quests.correctAnswer: The same qualification, in eighteen months instead of three years, at a fraction of the cost.
quests.hint: Lead with the time and cost saving together.
quests.explanation: Cutting both time and cost at once is one of the boldest pitches in education.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a weekend cookery school teaching restaurant techniques to complete beginners.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn the exact techniques restaurant chefs use, in just one relaxed weekend, with zero kitchen experience needed.
quests.hint: Reassure a total beginner that this is still for them.
quests.explanation: Reassuring beginners removes the intimidation that stops most people from ever booking a cookery class.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a platform that converts years of workplace experience into formal academic credit.
quests.correctAnswer: Years of real work experience count toward a real qualification, without repeating what you already know.
quests.hint: Highlight the validation of knowledge someone already has.
quests.explanation: Recognising existing knowledge, instead of repeating it, respects an experienced learner's time.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an upskilling platform focused entirely on skills that AI cannot easily replace.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn the human skills, like leadership and creative thinking, that no AI can convincingly replace.
quests.hint: Position the training directly against what AI can and can't do.
quests.explanation: Addressing a widely shared career worry head-on makes the pitch feel timely and relevant.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a weekend furniture-making workshop where beginners build their own piece to take home.
quests.correctAnswer: Walk in with no experience, and walk out carrying a piece of furniture you built yourself.
quests.hint: Focus on the pride of the finished piece, not the tools used.
quests.explanation: A tangible result someone can take home makes the whole experience easy to picture and want.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a public speaking course built entirely around realistic, high-pressure practice scenarios.
quests.correctAnswer: Practise the exact tough conversations you'll actually face, so real ones feel easy by comparison.
quests.hint: Highlight practice that transfers directly to real situations.
quests.explanation: Realistic practice builds confidence far faster than theory alone, because it mirrors the real challenge.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that teaches a new easy recipe from a different country every week.
quests.correctAnswer: Every week, one country, one simple recipe - a trip around the world from your own kitchen.
quests.hint: Frame the variety as a small journey, not just a recipe.
quests.explanation: Framing routine as a journey adds excitement to what could otherwise feel like an ordinary meal kit.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a currency and tipping guide app that adjusts instantly as you cross a border.
quests.correctAnswer: Cross a border, and it instantly shows the right currency and the right tip - no awkward guessing.
quests.hint: Lead with the moment of crossing the border.
quests.explanation: Anchoring the pitch to a specific travel moment makes an ordinary conversion tool feel essential.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a platform matching professionals with short courses based on their actual career goals.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell it your goal, and it points to the exact short course that gets you there fastest.
quests.hint: Lead with the goal-to-course matching, not the course catalogue.
quests.explanation: Matching by goal removes the overwhelming choice most course platforms leave learners to sort out alone.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a tutoring platform where university students earn money teaching school pupils online.
quests.correctAnswer: University students earn real money tutoring school pupils online - affordable help for families, fair pay for students.
quests.hint: Highlight the benefit on both sides equally.
quests.explanation: Solving a problem for both sides at once creates a naturally sustainable, scalable idea.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family photo-organising service that turns years of phone photos into printed yearly albums.
quests.correctAnswer: Hand over years of phone photos, and get back a beautiful printed album for every single year.
quests.hint: Focus on the relief of finally organising the mess.
quests.explanation: Relieving a task everyone dreads - sorting years of photos - is an easy, emotional selling point.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a homework help app powered by real qualified teachers rather than AI.
quests.correctAnswer: It's a real, qualified teacher on the other end, not an AI guess, when homework gets hard.
quests.hint: Position directly against AI-generated help with the human advantage.
quests.explanation: Standing firmly against AI-only help reassures any parent who wants a genuine expert involved.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a virtual robotics lab where students build and program robots entirely through a browser.
quests.correctAnswer: Design, build, and program a robot, all inside a browser - real STEM learning with zero hardware cost.
quests.hint: Highlight the zero-hardware access this opens up.
quests.explanation: Removing hardware costs opens robotics education to far more schools than before.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a weekend pottery class that welcomes total beginners with no experience needed.
quests.correctAnswer: No experience needed - just clay, guidance, and a finished piece you're proud to take home.
quests.hint: Reassure the complete beginner right at the start.
quests.explanation: Reassuring beginners early removes the main reason people never try a creative class in the first place.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a chemistry learning app using 3D molecular models that students can rotate and explore.
quests.correctAnswer: Rotate and explore real 3D molecules on your phone, making abstract chemistry suddenly easy to picture.
quests.hint: Highlight how tangible the 3D models make an abstract subject.
quests.explanation: Turning something abstract into something you can spin and see builds understanding no diagram can match.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an online creative writing community offering personal mentorship from published authors.
quests.correctAnswer: Get real, personal feedback from a published author - the kind of guidance most writing courses never offer.
quests.hint: Lead with the published author's access as the unique value.
quests.explanation: Access to a real published author is a unique value no algorithm-only platform can replicate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a music theory platform that teaches through songs the learner already loves.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn the theory hiding inside your favourite songs - the fastest route to understanding music you already love.
quests.hint: Lead with the familiar song as the hook.
quests.explanation: Learning through music someone already loves creates motivation no textbook exercise can generate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a photography walking tour that teaches beginners to shoot better photos with just their phone.
quests.correctAnswer: Walk, shoot, and learn - by the end, your phone photos finally look the way you imagined.
quests.hint: Focus on the gap between what people imagine and what they usually get.
quests.explanation: Naming the gap between hope and result is instantly familiar to anyone who's tried and been disappointed.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sports coaching app that analyses your technique from phone video with certified coach feedback.
quests.correctAnswer: Film yourself on your phone, and a certified coach sends back frame-by-frame feedback - elite coaching from your pocket.
quests.hint: Highlight professional-level feedback coming from an ordinary phone.
quests.explanation: Delivering certified coaching from an everyday phone video makes elite feedback newly accessible.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a platform connecting retired professional athletes with youth sports programmes as mentors.
quests.correctAnswer: A retired professional mentors your young player online - elite experience, made accessible for the very first time.
quests.hint: Lead with the accessibility of an elite experience.
quests.explanation: Access to elite experience is aspirational, which is exactly what makes families and clubs pay for it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a group cycling app that plans safe routes based on real-time traffic and weather.
quests.correctAnswer: It plans the safest route before you even set off, checking traffic and weather so you don't have to.
quests.hint: Focus on safety happening before the ride, not during it.
quests.explanation: Solving safety before the ride begins removes the anxiety that keeps some cyclists off the road.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a gamified budgeting app for people who find money genuinely stressful.
quests.correctAnswer: Hit a savings goal, earn a reward - budgeting that finally feels achievable instead of frightening.
quests.hint: Lead with the stress reduction, not the game mechanics.
quests.explanation: Turning money management into visible progress, rather than restriction, eases the anxiety many people feel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a financial literacy course taught entirely through the real stories of ordinary people.
quests.correctAnswer: Every lesson is a real person's story about debt, saving, or investing - lessons you actually remember.
quests.hint: Lead with how relatable real stories feel.
quests.explanation: Real stories stick in memory in a way that abstract financial rules on a page rarely do.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family finance app that teaches children saving through visible, child-chosen goals.
quests.correctAnswer: Kids pick their own goal and watch their savings grow toward it - saving finally feels real to them.
quests.hint: Lead with the child choosing the goal themselves.
quests.explanation: Letting a child choose their own goal builds motivation no parental instruction alone can create.
